title: Characteristics of Injury Claims by Chronic Pain Patients
official: Socio-demographics of Injury Insurance Claims by Chronic Pain Patients
summary: Chronic pain is associated with injuries and disabilities. This prospective observational study explores the injury or disability claims made by chronic pain patients. It evaluates the socio-demographics of the patient population. It explores the impact of pain clinic services on the patients' injury rehabilitation, insurance claim outcome, and socioeconomic situation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult chronic pain patients
* patients with injury claim

Exclusion Criteria:

* pediatric patients
* patients without injury claim
